EmailTemplate.textOnly: Thank you for joining us last week and helping make the first Flywire Forward a success! ‌ - View the content on-demand <[[https://flywire.foleon.com/events/flywire-forward?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> - revisit your favorite moments or check out sessions you may have missed. - Let us know what you think! If you haven't, fill out our short survey <[[https://www.surveymonkey.com/r/flywireforward?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]> to help us make the next Flywire Forward even better and earn the chance to win one of 5 Flywire Forward swag packs! - Enjoy the tunes? We put together the official Flywire Forward Spotify Playlist <[[https://open.spotify.com/playlist/7AtidIeyCOuv7nvyyAn5St?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email&si=150e995345934726]]> to brighten up your week. - Hungry for more trends? Reach out to forward@flywire.com. <[[mailto:foward@flywire.com]]> ‌ Have a great week!
